{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]'' by a similar name, see ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 23|"The Fifth, I Give You"]]''.}}
'''The Fifth''' is a custom among the [[Aiel]]. It states that after they conquer a place, they are entitled to take a fifth of all that the conquered hold has, save food.

In [[Caemlyn]], [[Tear]], and various other cities, the Aiel have been refused the right of the fifth by [[Rand al'Thor]], their prophesied ''[[Car'a'carn]]'', for the reason that he cannot afford for the Aiel to be seen as enemies, or for the areas to be weakened in the times of approaching war.{{ref/book|5|23}}
